IMPORTANT — PFAS against self-reported TOTAL PREGNANCY AND LIVE BIRTH NUMBERS, i.e. a parity outcome, which is the fertility quantity the review actually wants. It is also the record where reverse causation is maximal: parity causes exposure through three excretion routes, so a cross-sectional parity association is close to uninterpretable without parity-handling. Extract, and read against Call 2.
